Name: Better Artisan Good Icons for Magical Crops Revived
Author: Zer0p4nic
Description:
I just revived the mod ‘Better Artisan Good Icons for Magical Crops Revived’. It was a very simple task, only modifying 3 lines of the mod, so all credits go to the original author of the mod ‘[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Fate0of0man/about-me?gameId=1303]Fate0of0man[/url]’. If at any point they update their original mod, I will delete this one. (However, I plan to add the missing ‘Magical Crops’ for crafting)

[size=4]SV 1.6 Update:[/size]
The latest version of this mod will require [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url], which is the unofficial update for Better Artisan Good Icons.
